title: Fire tools!
description: firefighter tools based on real life tools
body:
A Texture pack designed to add Firefighter tools to minecraft using custom names.

# **Requires: Optifine or any CIT mods!**

## Tools names _(required to use the textures)_:
- Halligan Bar (pickaxe)
- Jaws of life (pickaxe)
- Fire axe (axe)
- Spreaders (sword)
- Fire beater (shovel)
- Pulaski (hoe)
- Cutters (shears)
- scba mask (elytra)
  
(has to be diamond or netherite tools)

# Notes:
1. the Elytra texture is temporary
2. There are currently some bugs
3. I tried to keep it vanilla looking
4. You have to use a CIT mod (including: optifine)
5. You need to use names to show the textures, allowing to see both Vanilla textures and The custom textures
6. For the names, stroll up to "Tools name"
For the names,
1. Copy the name between "-" and "(<tool>)"
2. (replace <tool> with the tool. has to be diamond or higher)
